findings: Full-model FSDP RL (no LoRA) on verl, with param+optimizer offload so Qwen3.5-4B fits on 4x A10G 24GB.
Qwen3.5's 3D mRoPE position_ids crash vanilla verl; three patches (patch_qwen35.py, patch_tensordict.py, patch_fix.py) are required and applied in the Dockerfile.
start_score=0.0 is the thinking-DISABLED SFT checkpoint (it emits empty output). This is not comparable to Tinker's thinking-enabled SFT-at-0.364 baseline.
Effective data after verl's filter_overlong_prompts is 235 train / 28 val (max_prompt_length=2048), so the val split is much smaller than Tinker's n=300.
estimated_cost_usd and wall_time_s are approximate (ml.g5.12xlarge on-demand ~$5.67/hr, ~90-100 min, ~388 s/step).
